E.notes: Official solution depends on run-length-compressed separation, preservation of existing-value order, number of missing values, circular distance and an even-N parity exception. This directly refutes the frozen frequency-only N!/m! hypothesis and requires a qualitatively new reachability/counting theorem.

D.notes: Official solution also models pairs as interval endpoints, reduces to an overlapping non-nested interval frontier, and maintains the optimum under prefix insertions in O(N log N). Frozen envelope formulation is independently equivalent and passed exact oracle/constraint gates.

C.notes: Official fixed-output count is a power of two determined by prefix-maximum/record updates and extends to O(N^2) DP for partial Q. This matches the frozen preimage-by-records derivation.
